subject.title: feat: add account feed model API

question: Should this first public account/publisher feed contract ship now, and should it preserve legacy personal-publisher rows by default before release?
rationale: The PR creates new externally observable API/schema surface, and the compatibility boundary for existing personal publishers is a product/API decision even though the recommended repair path is clear.

options.title: Fix compatibility and ship first slice
options.body: Reuse the existing personal-publisher fallback and legacy ownerUserId row handling, add regression coverage and live route proof, then let maintainers review the public contract.

options.title: Accept narrower ownerPublisherId-only feeds
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally ship the narrower contract, but the compatibility break for existing personal publisher content should be explicit.

options.title: Pause for discovery contract review
options.body: Keep the PR draft until the account feed and registry bridge contracts are reviewed together.

recommendation.title: Fix compatibility and ship first slice
recommendation.body: Reuse the existing personal-publisher fallback and legacy ownerUserId row handling, add regression coverage and live route proof, then let maintainers review the public contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is the clearest routing owner from current-main blame for publisher compatibility paths and recent merge ownership around the adjacent publisher dashboard work.
